product_wide_rationale: Defines the Domain model itself, including what a Domain is and how law homes to one. A record that creates the partition cannot be owned by a Domain inside it.
summary: Makes Product law and architectural concordance Priority 1; canonical Domains own law and bind Product-changing work; shared Product writes require an overlap resolution, and revisions make it stale only when judged architecture content changes; architecture-only proximity does not block; Initiative remains secondary context; SQLite remains sole local authority. CD-0042 amends sequencing, CD-0144 moves the claim to execution start, CD-0145 narrows blocking writes, and CD-0153 refines staleness. The 2026-09-22 operator correction makes the Product work list the browse entry with Domain and law context one reachable step away.
title: Architecture-bound Product law is Concord's primary coordination model
